full.description: Every document at the ref: every design record (everything inheriting DesignRecord), every User and every Grant (ADR-0068). The only slice that reproduces the graph when re-imported.

outcomes-loop.description: The position paper's needs-to-objectives-to-outcomes path (Narrative 1): evidence, needs and their links; objectives and prerequisites; items, their placements and assessments; the modules and course they sit in and the objectives modules declare; datasets and metrics. Leaves out activities, notes, findings and attestations. A metric whose subject is an activity is reported as unresolved.

review.description: The review record: items and the findings, notes and attestations about them, with their authors. For studying how review happens, not what was taught. Subjects that are not items are reported as unresolved.
